test_is_onnxrt_backend_supported: test if ONNX Runtime dependencies are installed and usable for TorchDynamo backend integration
build_OrtBackend: build an ONNX Runtime backend for torch.compile with configurable execution providers and session options
create_OrtBackendOptions: create backend options specifying execution providers, output preallocation, and aot_autograd settings
run_OrtBackend_compile: run the OrtBackend compile method to partition an FX graph module into ONNX-representable sub-graphs executed by ORT
summarize_torch_compile_backend: summarize the torch_compile_backend function that wraps OrtBackend for use as a torch.compile backend
